relationships.subject: mTOR
relationships.evidence_quote: activated mTOR (via Akt and mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) signaling) inhibits autophagy

relationships.subject: PI3K/Akt/mTOR pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: Activation of the PI3K/Akt/mTOR pathway primarily negatively regulates autophagy.

relationships.subject: P2X7
relationships.evidence_quote: the stimulation of purinergic ligand-gated ion channel type 7 receptor (P2X7R) in microglia can hinder autophagy by interfering with the fusion of autophagosomes and lysosomes

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Increased levels of calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) may also modulate autophagy through the Akt/mTOR or protein kinase A (PKA)/mTOR signaling pathways.

key_findings: Review proposes autophagy inhibition via PI3K/Akt/mTOR and P2X7 in microglia contributes to migraine central sensitization.
CGRP may modulate autophagy through Akt/mTOR or PKA/mTOR.
